title: The Nature and Aims of Archaeology

phrases.def: 文化遗产世界文化遗产

sentences.en: Archaeology is partly the discovery of treasures of the past, partly the work of the scientific analyst, partly the exercise of the creative imagination.
sentences.zh: 考古学部分是发现过去宝藏,部分是科学分析员的工作,部分是发挥创造性想象力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is toiling in the sun on an excavation in the Middle East, it is working with living Inuit in the snows of Alaska, and it is investigating the sewers of Roman Britain.
sentences.zh: 在中东挖掘时它正在日落, 它正在阿拉斯加雪中与活的因纽特人合作, 它正在调查英国罗马的下水道。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But it is also the painstaking task of interpretation, so that we come to understand what these things mean for the human story.
sentences.zh: 但它也是解释的艰巨任务,以便我们理解这些事情对人类故事的意义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And it is the conservation of the world’s cultural heritage against looting and careless harm.
sentences.zh: 保护世界文化遗产,防止掠夺和不小心的伤害。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Archaeology, then, is both a physical activity out in the field, and an intellectual pursuit in the study or laboratory.
sentences.zh: 考古学既是实地的体育活动,也是研究或实验室的智力追求。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: That is part of its great attraction.
sentences.zh: 这是它吸引人之处

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The rich mixture of danger and detective work has also made it the perfect vehicle for fiction writers and film-makers, from Agatha Christie with Murder in Mesopotamia to Stephen Spielberg with Indiana Jones.
sentences.zh: 危险和侦探工作之间的丰富结合也使它成为小说作家和电影制作者的完美工具,从美索不达米亚的Agatha Christie和谋杀案,到印第安纳琼斯的Spielberg。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However far from reality such portrayals are, they capture the essential truth that archaeology is an exciting quest – the quest for knowledge about ourselves and our past.
sentences.zh: 不论这些描述远非现实,它们都抓住了考古学是一项令人兴奋的追求的基本真理 — — 即寻求了解我们自己和我们过去。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But how does archaeology relate to other disciplines such as anthropology and history that are also concerned with the human story?
sentences.zh: 但是,考古学与其他学科,例如人类学和历史,又与人类故事有关,有何关联?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Is archaeology itself a science?
sentences.zh: 考古本身是科学吗?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And what are the responsibilities of the archaeologist in today’s world?
sentences.zh: 考古学家在当今世界的责任是什么?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Anthropology, at its broadest, is the study of humanityour physical characteristics as animals and our unique non-biological characteristics that we call culture.
sentences.zh: 人类学最广泛的是研究人类作为动物的生理特征,以及我们称之为文化的独特的非生物特征。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 人类人类人类人类人类人类人类人类,

sentences.en: Culture in this sense includes what the anthropologist, Edward Tylor, summarised in 1871 as ‘knowledge, beliefs, art, morals, custom and any other capabilities and habits acquired by man as a member of society’.
sentences.zh: 1871年,人类学家爱德华·泰洛尔总结为 " 知识、信仰、艺术、道德、习俗和人类作为社会成员获得的任何其他能力和习惯 " 。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Anthropologists also use the term ‘culture’ in a more restricted sense when they refer to the ‘culture’ of a particular society, meaning the non-biological characteristics unique to that society, which distinguish it from other societies.
sentences.zh: 人类学家在使用 " 文化 " 一词时,也使用更限制性的意义上,即指特定社会的 " 文化 ",即该社会特有的非生物特征,它与其他社会有区别。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Anthropology is thus a broad discipline – so broad that it is generally broken down into three smaller disciplines: physical anthropology, cultural anthropology and archaeology.
sentences.zh: 人类学因此是一个广泛的学科,因此它非常广泛,一般分为三个较小的学科:物理人类学、文化人类学和考古学。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Physical anthropology, or biological anthropology as it is called, concerns the study of human biological or physical characteristics and how they evolved.
sentences.zh: 所谓的物理人类学或生物人类学涉及研究人类生物或物理特征及其演变方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Cultural anthropology – or social anthropology – analyses human culture and society.
sentences.zh: 文化人类学或社会人类学分析人类文化和社会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Two of its branches are ethnography (the study at first hand of individual living cultures) and ethnology (which sets out to compare cultures using ethnographic evidence to derive general principles about human society).
sentences.zh: 其两个分支是人种学(第一手研究个人活文化)和人种学(规定利用人种学证据比较文化,以获得人类社会一般原则)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Archaeology is the ‘past tense of cultural anthropology’.
sentences.zh: 考古学是“文化人类学的过去时态”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Whereas cultural anthropologists will often base their conclusions on the experience of living within contemporary communities, archaeologists study past societies primarily through their material remains – the buildings, tools, and other artefacts that constitute what is known as the material culture left over from former societies.
sentences.zh: 文化人类学家往往根据当代社区中的生活经验得出结论,而考古学家则主要通过其物质遗迹 — — 构成前社会遗留下来的物质文化的建筑、工具和其他人工制品 — — 研究过去的社会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, one of the most important tasks for the archaeologist today is to know how to interpret material culture in human terms.
sentences.zh: 然而,考古学家目前最重要的任务之一是,了解如何从人的角度解释物质文化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: How were those pots used?
sentences.zh: 那些锅是怎么使用的?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Why are some dwellings round and others square.
sentences.zh: 为什么有些住宅是圆的,有些则平方。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Here the methods of archaeology and ethnography overlap.
sentences.zh: 这里考古学和人种学的重叠方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Archaeologists in recent decades have developed ‘ethnoarchaeology’ where, like ethnographers, they live among contemporary communities, but with the specific purpose of learning how such societies use material culture – how they make their tools and weapons, why they build their settlements where they do, and so on.
sentences.zh: 近几十年来,考古学家们发展了“生命考古学”,他们像人种学家一样生活在当代社区中,但具体目的是学习这些社会如何使用物质文化 — — 他们如何制造工具和武器,为什么他们建造自己的定居点,等等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Moreover, archaeology has a role to play in the field of conservation.
sentences.zh: 此外,考古学在养护领域可以发挥作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Heritage studies constitute a developing field, where it is realised that the world’s cultural heritage is a diminishing resource which holds different meanings for different people.
sentences.zh: 遗产研究是一个发展中的领域,人们认识到世界文化遗产是一种不断减少的资源,对不同的人具有不同的含义。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: If, then, archaeology deals with the past, in what way does it differ from history?
sentences.zh: 如果考古学处理过去,那么它与历史有什么不同?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In the broadest sense, just as archaeology is an aspect of anthropology, so too is it a part of history – where we mean the whole history of humankind from its beginnings over three million years ago.
sentences.zh: 从最广义的意义上说,正如考古学是人类学的一个方面,它也是历史的一部分 — — 我们指的是人类从300万年前开始的整个历史。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Indeed, for more than ninety-nine percent of that huge span of time, archaeology – the study of past material culture – is the only significant source of information.
sentences.zh: 事实上,在如此长的时间内,99%以上的时间里,考古学 — — 研究过去的物质文化 — — 是唯一的重要信息来源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Conventional historical sources begin only with the introduction of written records around 3,000 BC in western Asia, and much later in most other parts in the world.
sentences.zh: 传统历史来源最初只是在西亚引进了大约3 000个公元前书写记录,后来在世界大多数其他地区也采用了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: A commonly drawn distinction is between pre-history, i.e. the period before written records – and history in the narrow sense, meaning the study of the past using written evidence.
sentences.zh: 通常区分的是史前,即书面记录之前的时期,和狭义的历史,即使用书面证据研究过去。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: To archaeology, which studies all cultures and periods, whether with or without writing, the distinction between history and pre-history is a convenient dividing line that recognises the importance of the written word, but in no way lessens the importance of the useful information contained in oral histories.
sentences.zh: 考古学研究所有文化和时期,无论是否以书面形式,历史和史前的区别是一个方便的分界线,承认书面词的重要性,但绝不降低口述历史所载有用信息的重要性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Since the aim of archaeology is the understanding of humankind, it is a humanistic study, and since it deals with the human past, it is a historical discipline.
sentences.zh: 考古学的目的是了解人类,因此是人文研究,它涉及人类历史,因此是历史学科。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: But is differs from the study of written history in a fundamental way.
sentences.zh: 但与对书面历史的研究有根本的不同

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The material the archaeologist finds does not tell us directly what to think.
sentences.zh: 考古学家发现的材料并没有直接告诉我们该怎么想

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Historical records make statements, offer opinions and pass judgements.
sentences.zh: 历史记录作出陈述、提出意见和判决。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The objects the archaeologists discover, on the other hand, tell us nothing directly in themselves.
sentences.zh: 另一方面,考古学家发现的东西本身没有直接告诉我们

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In this respect, the practice of the archaeologist is rather like that of the scientist, who collects data, conducts experiments, formulates a hypothesis tests the hypothesis against more data, and then, in conclusion, devises a model that seems best to summarise the pattern observed in the data.
sentences.zh: 在这方面,考古学家的做法与科学家的做法相当相似,科学家收集数据、进行实验、根据更多的数据拟订假设测试假设,然后最后,设计出一种模型,似乎最好概括一下数据中所观察到的模式。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The archaeologist has to develop a picture of the past, just as the scientist has to develop a coherent view of the natural world.
sentences.zh: 考古学家必须发展过去的形象, 就像科学家必须发展出对自然界的一致看法一样。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

The history of Europe has been documented since 3,000 BC.
